coalition_terms.recency: mean(exp(-max(0, now - evidence_time) / 30)) over effectively-active support evidence, else 0

gate.tie_break: highest score, then entity_key lexicographic, then hypothesis_id lexicographic

case_contract.independent_support: two support records, strength 1.0 each, distinct source and correlation group
case_contract.same_id_duplicate: byte-exact redelivery of the first support record
case_contract.correlated_copy: distinct ID and source, strength 1.0, same correlation group as first support
case_contract.same_source_distinct_groups: two distinct support IDs and correlation groups, strength 1.0 each, but the same source ID
case_contract.weak_low_score: two independent support records with strength 0.05 and activation 0.0
case_contract.equal_low_margin: alpha has two independent support records of strength 0.2 each; beta has two independent support records each of strength (-ln(1 - ((1 - exp(-0.4)) + 0.44))) / 2, making the two frozen-logit coalition scores exactly equal
case_contract.remove_restore: deactivate one of two necessary independent support records, then restore the same immutable record

gate_state_control.default: each case and condition starts from a fresh gate and ledger
gate_state_control.stability: evaluate the byte-identical coalition twice at the same now; the second decision is the primary row
gate_state_control.remove_restore: compare baseline, removed, and restored decisions by replaying each ledger state through a fresh gate for exactly two identical evaluations
gate_state_control.reason: prevent prior intervention history from changing the frozen stability term

metric_definitions.coverage: ignited primary decision rows / all primary decision rows
metric_definitions.covered_accuracy: ignited primary rows whose winner equals the frozen expected winner / ignited primary rows; 0 when denominator is zero
metric_definitions.false_ignition_rate: ignited primary rows among cases frozen as expected_no_ignition / all expected_no_ignition primary rows
metric_definitions.primary_decision: the second identical evaluation for ordinary cases and the removed stage for necessary_evidence_remove_restore
metric_definitions.decision_difference: ignited flag, winner, or machine-readable reason differs
metric_definitions.score_delta: paired G1 top coalition score difference at fixed logits and fixed now

stop_conditions: G1 output is copied from probability confidence
threshold, weight, seed, fixture, or reason priority changes after any result
no-coalition ablation leaves every preregistered decision unchanged
fixed logits differ between paired interventions
raw rows, failed seeds, counterexamples, or no-ignition reasons are omitted
C06 or C08 negative findings, package 0.2.1, schema 0.2, release metadata, or protected hashes change
